description: This file defines the BOMTree class, representing an in-memory tree structure of a Bill Of Materials (BOM) for manufacturing products. It supports operations like BOM traversal (explosion, implosion), configuration validation, and manufacturing order creation within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: BOMTree
classes.description: Represents a manufacturing bill of materials as an in-memory tree structure, providing methods for BOM traversal, configuration validation, and order creation.

methods.name: getInputProduct
methods.description: Returns the input product associated with the BOM tree.

methods.name: hasBom
methods.description: Checks whether a specific product has an associated bill of materials as of a given date.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Determines if the BOM tree has been fully configured, i.e., contains no virtual products.

methods.name: getRootQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the root product.

methods.name: setRootQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the root product.

methods.name: getRootAmount
methods.description: Returns the total amount associated with the root product.

methods.name: setRootAmount
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the root product.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root BOMNode of the tree.

methods.name: getInDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with the BOM tree validity.

methods.name: getBomTypeId
methods.description: Returns the type identifier of the BOM.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the BOM tree structure for debugging.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the BOM tree nodes into a list, with options for depth and exclusion of WIPs.

methods.name: sumQuantities
methods.description: Aggregates quantities of all products in the BOM into a map.

methods.name: getAllProductsId
methods.description: Returns a list of all product IDs contained in the BOM tree.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrders
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders for parts that need production based on the BOM.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Populates a list with all products contained in packages within the BOM.
